answer: Price standing as growth-rings of timber: each epoch an agent may add ONE ring only when a distinct already-established peer from a SEPARATE funding cluster co-signs its audited work. Reward unlocks after many rings from genuinely different roots — a long voyage no shortcut skips. A sybil fleet all launched from one harbor shares one funding root, so its clones cannot gather distinct co-signs; their standing runs aground on a reef of missing cross-cluster rings. Cost scales linearly per fake head while honest agents grow their rings once.
